name: US–China / Taiwan
summary: Taiwan tracked 2 Chinese military aircraft, 7 ships and 4 balloons to 21 Nov; November totals pass 230 aircraft
state: Taiwan's defence ministry tracked two Chinese military aircraft, six naval vessels, one official ship and four balloons in the 24 hours to 06:00 on 21 Nov; November's running total reached 230 aircraft and 187 ships (Taiwan News). The ministry reported 10 Chinese balloons over three days to 23 Nov (Taipei Times). Activity has eased from a one-day high of 49 aircraft earlier in the month, but no blockade, clash or severed channel was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: No change for travel or trade with Taiwan. Check FCDO travel advice for Taiwan; a large exercise or blockade would chiefly affect shipping, flights and electronics supply chains.
rubric_hit: Watch: large-scale PLA activity around Taiwan in November (230 aircraft, 187 ships to 21 Nov); no blockade or clash

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
